# Packt Subscription

> > Packt Subscription provides 7,500+ eBooks and videos for tech professionals to advance knowledge in programming, AI, data science, and modern software development.

Packt Subscription is a comprehensive learning platform offering access to curated technical content including the complete 'Building AI Agents with LLMs, RAG, and Knowledge Graphs' course by Salvatore Raieli. The platform focuses on practical, hands-on learning for AI, machine learning, and software engineering professionals.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Knowledge Graphs
- AI Agents
- Transformer Architecture
- Attention Mechanisms
- Deep Learning
- LangChain
- PyTorch
- Natural Language Processing
- Reinforcement Learning
- Web Scraping
- Streamlit
- Text Embeddings
- Information Retrieval

## AI Agents & LLM Fundamentals

- [Part 1: The AI Agent Engine: From Text to Large Language Models](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/1): Foundational concepts of AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and Knowledge Graphs by Salvatore Raieli
- [Chapter 1: Analyzing Text Data with Deep Learning](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/2): Tutorial on analyzing text data using Deep Learning, BoW, and TF-IDF techniques
- [Chapter 2: The Transformer: The Model Behind the Modern AI Revolution](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/3): Guide on Transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and LLM fundamentals
- [Chapter 3: Exploring LLMs as a Powerful AI Engine](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/4): LLM engines using PyTorch, Hugging Face, and practical AI agent setup

## RAG & Knowledge Retrieval Systems

- [Part 2: AI Agents and Retrieval of Knowledge](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/5): Overview of AI agents, RAG systems, Knowledge Graphs, and GraphRAG techniques
- [Chapter 4: Building a Web Scraping Agent with an LLM](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/6): Tutorial on building web scraping agents using LangChain, PyTorch, and LLMs
- [Chapter 5: Extending Your Agent with RAG to Prevent Hallucinations](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/7): RAG implementation to prevent LLM hallucinations and improve information retrieval
- [Chapter 6: Advanced RAG Techniques for Information Retrieval and Augmentation](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/8): Guide on advanced RAG techniques, query handling, and retrieval pipeline optimization

## Knowledge Graphs & Agent Architecture

- [Chapter 7: Creating and Connecting a Knowledge Graph to an AI Agent](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/9): Tutorial on Knowledge Graph construction, enrichment, and LLM agent integration
- [Chapter 8: Reinforcement Learning and AI Agents](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/10): Deep reinforcement learning, policy learning, and neural network value functions
- [Chapter 9: Creating Single- and Multi-Agent Systems](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/12): Single and multi-agent architecture with travel planning and recommendation systems

## Production Deployment & Applications

- [Part 3: Creating Sophisticated AI to Solve Complex Scenarios](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/11): Multi-agent systems, production deployment with Streamlit and Docker
- [Chapter 10: Building an AI Agent Application](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/13): Tutorial on building Streamlit-based AI agent applications with travel planning system
- [Chapter 11: The Future Ahead](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/14): Future AI agent applications in biomedical, robotics, gaming, and web automation
